photographer_note: Photographer field may be a generic attribution string such as 'no rights reserved' and cannot establish unique individuals or photographers.

method: Extract /photos/{id}/ from GBIF attribution.json URL, compare against photo_id from replacement download report; validator deduplicates medium image bytes within replacement batch. Baseline SHA-256 refers to original images and candidate SHA-256 to medium images, so their hashes must not be compared as if same-resolution.
limitations: No photo_id overlap only excludes identical iNaturalist uploads, not different crops or photos of the same plant.
No cross-source perceptual/image-content duplicate check was run.
No botanical identity or visual framing approval.
Attribution grouping is not a verified photographer identity or independent plant grouping.
